summary: Tested Karma Cleanse v2.1 backend + frontend. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS (analyze, certificate CRUD, checkout, delivery scheduling, validation). Frontend: Landing → Identity → Confession works, but submitting the confession does NOT progress to Processing/Severity — clicking SUBMIT INCIDENT REPORT yields no state change, no navigation, and confession step persists. Subsequent steps (Severity, Protocol, Certificate view) could not be reached via UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'SUBMIT INCIDENT REPORT' does nothing — funnel stuck at confession step. No console errors visible but state does not advance to ProcessingRitual.

integration_issues.issue: Entire post-confession funnel unreachable via UI; backend /api/analyze + /api/certificate confirmed working via direct calls, so the bug is in the frontend handler (likely ritualStore submitConfession or routing in App.js).

issues: Brutalist design renders well — black text on off-white, monospace, ministry seal displayed, live counter visible. Design intent met.

action_items: Debug ConfessionStep submit handler — verify submitConfession in /app/frontend/src/store/ritualStore.js correctly calls POST /api/analyze, awaits result, and transitions step (or navigates to /processing).
Check whether button is actually wired to onClick handler or if there's a silent JS exception. Add error handling/toast in submit flow.
Verify React Router routes for /processing, /severity, /protocol, /certificate/:uuid are configured in App.js and that the store/state machine triggers navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is reasonably structured but >400 lines — consider splitting routers (certificate, checkout, delivery) into modules.
models.py uses Pydantic correctly; MongoDB _id properly excluded with projection {'_id': 0}. Good.
Backend correctly enforces server-side pricing in PRICING_TIERS (frontend cannot inject amounts). Good security.
RESEND_API_KEY is a placeholder — expected per request; /api/delivery/schedule only stores record (no actual send), so scheduling works.
No authentication on any endpoint — matches spec but means anyone can create/read certificates by UUID guess (UUIDs are non-enumerable so acceptable).

Frontend: data-testid attributes present on all tested interactive elements (landing-page, begin-cleansing-btn, live-counter, identity-input, register-identity-btn, remain-anonymous-btn, confession-textarea, submit-incident-btn). Good testability.
test_credentials: No auth — Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 not exercised since funnel blocked before payment.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed certificate via direct backend API in pytest fixture (not via UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully validated by /app/backend/tests/test_karma_api.py. Focus next iteration on frontend post-confession flow once main agent fixes the submit-incident-btn handler. Try clicking submit-incident-btn and confirm navigation to a /processing route or rendering of ProcessingRitual component. Then validate: progress bar, transition to SeverityResult with color-coded stamp, ProtocolSelection with 4 tiers (free/standard $1/premium $3/enterprise $7), free-tier path → CertificateView with QR code + share + schedule delivery form.
rca of the issue: Frontend Confession submit button click does not transition state. Backend /api/analyze works (verified via pytest). Likely root cause is in /app/frontend/src/pages/ConfessionStep.js or /app/frontend/src/store/ritualStore.js: either submitConfession is not awaited, navigation (useNavigate) is missing, or an exception is swallowed. Reproduction: open app → BEGIN KARMA CLEANSING → enter name → REGISTER IDENTITY → type 5+ chars in textarea → click SUBMIT INCIDENT REPORT → page stays on Incident Declaration.
